clips.title: The story
paras: Troggs now bar the road through Coldridge Pass, the way out of Coldridge Valley.

Coldridge Pass carries recruits from Coldridge Valley toward Kharanos. The tunnel cuts through Dun Morogh’s southern mountain ridge, linking the sheltered training grounds to the wider kingdom. Troggs have overrun the passage and threaten anyone crossing between the valley and the rest of Dun Morogh.
